Now that their teenage years are over, they have to face the obstacles of life and are forced to make big choices. But the bond that binds them all together will surely lead them to their own "happiness".

At his uncle’s funeral, Jeonghan is reunited with Iljo, a man he hasn’t seen in years. It turns out Iljo’s struggling to stay afloat. Stirred by pity and charitable impulse, Jeonghan invites Iljo to move in with him. The problem is that Iljo catches feelings like a match to fuel. To top it off, Jeonghan isn’t keen on dating him, but somehow, he’s a pro at accidentally making things a lot messier for everyone involved. But regardless of all of Gyeo-wool’s efforts, the enormous amount of pressure he puts on himself as the leader of his new idol group, “Pale Green,” causes him to spend his days wallowing in anxiety and self-doubt. That is, until one day, Gyeo-Wool discovers a gentle hand repeatedly helping him from the shadows. A hand that belongs to “Gyeol,” an experienced idol belonging to the massively popular group, “Kimberly.” Although Gyeo-Wool is grateful for his reliable and handsome sunbae, he can’t help but wonder… Why is Gyeol treating him like he’s special?

Through breeding and genetic manipulation, dinosaur populations increased and dino-mania reached a fever pitch worldwide…until a certain terrible incident occurred. When her best friend found her first boyfriend, Hikaru became impatient and started playing with a dating app. She met Kento, a handsome working man, thru the app, and they hit it off and spent the night together. Locked up in a strange room with his hands and feet bound, Taichi wonders if his life is about to end when the murderer suddenly licks his ear! The masked man then plants himself in a chair and starts staring at him. Taichi's puzzled, wondering what's happening, when his captor says he's fallen for him. And Taichi had thought the guy wanted to kill him! In a desperate attempt to get away, he tells the murderer that the feeling is mutual. The next thing he knows, the guy suddenly gets physical! 132072.description:
Haruhi's sick of being bossed around by his younger stepbrother, Akito, and tells him he's had enough. Haruhi's too nice, though. Upon seeing Akito's sad expression, he tries to console his brother, only for Akito to kiss him right then and there! Haruhi's never seen Akito so desperate. Akito doesn't hate him!? ...But, why show it with a kiss!? Akito's behavior escalates, and Haruhi's still not sure what's going on in his brother's head. This is a romantic comedy about two stepbrothers in a taboo relationship. One's besotted yet stand-offish, and the other's entirely at his mercy!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: This Is Taking Brotherly Love Way Too Far
title.native: これもブラコンのうちですか?
title.romaji: Kore mo Brocon no Uchi desu ka?

132073.description:
"If anyone were to see me like this, they'd think I was a total perv."

The sound of the camera shutter echoes in the student council room. Blindfolded, hands and feet bound, chained to a desk... Aroused and panting sweetly, Student Council President Kanade Sanhoin's a narcissist who gets off hard on this kind of fantasy role play. He's into modeling for adult video covers, and today's no exception as he's drunk on his own attractiveness. Things get a little hairy, though, when his lost, adult-photo-filled smart phone is picked up and returned by an aggressive younger classmate!

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: The Student Council President Wants to be a Manservant
title.native: 生徒会長は下僕になりたい

132074.description:
Well-formed muscles are his favorite thing! Kasumi's hobby is observing the bodies of jocks while they play sports. One day, Kasumi sees a boy, Fujinuma, with a very shapely behind! Kasumi wants nothing more than to make a photographic record of Fujinuma's perfect body... Not satisfied with just watching, Kasumi invites Fujinuma to his place. Beaming innocently at the flawlessly sculpted body in front of him, Kasumi can't help asking Fujinuma to do something outrageous!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 理不尽なフェティッシュ

132075.description:
Former office worker Isshin quits his office job to do hard physical labor in the delivery business. As the daily grind wears down his body and soul, his only solace is working with his beloved coworker Haze. Haze has it all - good looks and excellent occupational skills. One day, just when Isshin's starting to feel like Haze's titillating presence makes his job worthwhile, he makes a mistake during a delivery and Haze has to pick up after him. On top of that, he gets blackout drunk and makes a total disgrace of himself. When he wakes up, he finds himself with no clothes on, and Haze by his bedside asking if he remembers what happened last night... That one moment of despair might be the catalyst that brings them together...

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

瑠璃も玻璃も照らせば光る

132078.description:
Aimi may be popular, but the fact that he's trashy is known by everyone—even himself! He'll go out with anyone as long as he's not tied down to just one person. But now he's dating Kaede, a very convenient underclassman who doesn't ask for anything and doesn't say anything unnecessary. But isn't it strange that Kaede's attitude doesn't change even when he sees Aimi kissing a sex friend? Thrown off by this, Aimi starts to become possessive of Kaede. However, his feelings don't seem to be reaching Kaede at all...

(Source: Yen Press)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.english: I Don’t Know How to Love
title.native: 恋の仕方がわからない

132079.description:
Haunted by past trauma, Kana has kept his identity as a sexual minority hidden throughout his life. He’s never told anyone and has been carrying the weight alone. But when his friend brings him to a college mixer, one of the people sitting among the girls was Keigo, a guy who casually reveals that he’s gay. Their first meeting was a disaster. They couldn’t have been more incompatible. But as they continue to encounter, connect with, and confront one another, they begin to realize emotions they have never felt before. Time, which had long been paused for these two uncertain young men, quietly starts to flow once more.

(Source: Takeshobo, translated)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

title.native: インサイド フルブルーム

132083.description: Senyuu+ tells stories about Senyuu characters that take place before, during or after the story of the original webcomic.

132084.description:
"+" Was pretending to be too magnificent ...!? After many adventures, Alba, who pursues peace in all the world, appears as the greatest enemy in history !! Is it light or darkness that controls the world?

(Source: Seiga Nicovideo, translated)

132085.description:
The manga remake of the homonym webcomic.

Note: Includes 9 extra chapters.

132086.description:
Movie lover Seo Dong-Ju and genius composer Han Da-Un's first encounter couldn't be worse! But after they accidentally reunite at school and get acquainted, they grow more and more curious about each other... The two boys’ chaotic and heart-fluttering melody unfolds~

(Source: Kakao, translated)

132087.description:
The idle Taoist Priest Mo Chuan accidentally summoned an ancient spirit animal (can turn into human shape) who had been sealed for hundreds of years and made a contract with him. Mo Chuan wanted to seal him again while the spirit animal wants to kill him so he could get his freedom. They started a war of schemes. What they didn't expect was... after spending a while together, their feelings for each other also started to change...

(Source: Webnovel)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.romaji: SSSS.GRIDMAN: Shinseiki Chuugakusei no Shitsuji Cafe

132090.description: Kiyosumi has never had trouble meeting women, so he's in no hurry to find a steady girlfriend. One day, he got roped into a mixer party by a work colleague, and there he met Mashiro. They left the party together and he was planning on a one-night stand then say goodbye to her in the morning like usual. But he got surprised when she took the initiative and  told him about their past history together—!? Who will have the advantage in a revenge-love story between a playboy ex-boyfriend and an ex-girlfriend who won't give up so easily this time!

title.native: ピュアホワイトアウト

132092.description:
After a painful breakup, Michinobu moves to another town to get away from everything. He stumbles upon a young boy who invites him to join him for a meal. In the days following, the two meet often and have meals together, forming a healing friendship.

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

132093.description:
The world is in constant turmoil, with constant wars breaking out between Heroes and Villains. Gifted with supernatural abilities, one lone girl sets out on a bloody path for revenge against the injustices of the world she lives in. With the constant clashes between titans, no one is safe. If no one is willing to protect the innocent, who are the real heroes, and who are the real villains? What truly separates one from the other?

(Source: WEBTOON)

132094.description:
Ever since he was young, Hee-Min has always liked his neighbour, Seon-Woo-hyung. Hee-Min had given up on Seon-Woo after he had moved away. However, coincidentally, while Seon-Woo is searching for a roommate, Hee-Min is able to meet him once again. But, the love rival that has appeared in front of Hee-Min now is none other than his older brother, Yoo-Min!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)

132095.description:
Ritsuko is a virtuous wife who lives with her son and husband.
One day, her son's best friend, Ryo, comes to her with a serious look on his face and hands her a DVD.
The DVD shows her son, Takeshi, and Ryo's mother having an illicit affair. Ryo looks overwhelmed.
"You treat my mother like a bitch! I'm going to fuck you and make it even!" He shouted.
He attacked Ritsuko.
Ritsuko accepts Ryo's body out of guilt and pity, but she soon finds herself drowning in his young body...

(Source: Magazine Magazine, translated)

132097.description:
The story of Hui-Ye, who is currently attending a middle school for girls, and Seo-Yun, her senior at school and someone that caught Hui-Ye's eye instantly.

(Source: Comico, translated)
synonyms: The Distance Between You and Me

132098.description:
What if one mistake changed your entire life? Three couples fall into a cruel twist of fate.

(Source: Toomics)

Note: Includes one extra chapter.

132100.description: A series of short stories from the magazine "War B-Gumi".

132101.description:
The story of a passion burning so hot that it can't be extinguished. The excitement of forbidden love and a new indescribable pleasure. Karen is an employee at an advertising agency. Through the many twists and turns of life, she moves from the countryside and a broken relationship to the bright lights and opportunities of the big city. She is standing on her own two feet now. One night, when she goes out with friends, she ends up having a little too much to drink and falls over on a stranger's table. Putting the embarrassing incident behind her, she continues on with her life. But, a few days later at a business meeting, she discovers her client is none other than the man she fell over on, Shuji Kano! As Karen learns more about Shuji, his wife, and his mistress, she is drawn to his mysterious and charming personality. Neither of them understands love, but... they're about to start exploring it together!

(Source: Renta!)

132106.description:
A fantasy survival where three people (a prisoner of war, a cook and an alchemist) struggle to survive on an uninhabited island! What do you have to do first on an uninhabited island? How do you secure a water source? What is the point of collecting food? Overcome a tough, but a little fun life with alchemy!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title.native: 錬金術無人島サヴァイブ
ふたなりヌーディストバカンス

132108.description: Even though she's in the brass band, Shoko gets extreme case stage fright. So she plays the contrabass in order hide in the corner out of sight of the audience. But then Shoko's junior band-mate Chiyoko asked her to play a duet on center stage at the school festival. She didn't want to disappoint Chiyoko, who had joined the band after she saw Shoko's performance. Now if only her legs would stop shaking...

132111.description:
In middle school, Noka lost both of her parents in an accident and her distant cousins Yashiro and Toki volunteered to take her in. Living together with these two handsome, overprotective brothers, every day is fun, but as Noka grows older, cohabitation becomes more and more... steamy.

(Source: Brite Shuppan, translated)

132113.description:
I’ve become a part of this Wuxia novel as Lihwa, the thoughtful and gentle daughter of Cheon Ma… who’s also the ultimate villain! Known as the Demon King and ruthless leader of the Demonic Sect, he resorts to kidnapping and other nefarious deeds to make sure a boy named Ak Wuryeon never reaches his full potential. Wuryeon doesn’t seem THAT bad, but I know he’ll one day exact his revenge on my father and that includes me! Can I escape the clutches of my father’s enemies and my doomed destiny before it’s too late?

(Source: Tapas)

132115.description:
In a futuristic society populated solely by women, the lonely heir to a powerful conglomerate finds unlikely companionship in her android housekeeper. When the android breaks down suddenly one day, she gives up her wealth and status to take off on a grand intergalactic quest to save her beloved.

(Source: Irodori Comics)

132116.description: Summoned to a world where the concept of cooking doesn't exist, the young chef Leo must now prepare some delicious dishes for one devilish customer! Join him and the curious glutton Renatos on their quest for new and exciting meals in this all-you-can-eat isekai tale!

title.romaji: Isekai Chef to Saikyou Boushoku Hime

132117.description:
Shinichi, unable to control his twisted sexual desire for his overly beautiful mother, Mihori, obtains a suspicious drug and sets a trap for her. As intended, Shinichi succeeds in turning his mother into a toy, but the people around him begin to notice something strange about the two of them. And everyone who comes close to their suspicions is caught up in their murky desires.

(Source: Leed Publishing)

132119.description:
When a swarm of giant bugs threatens to wipe out humanity, the world’s only defense is a group of humans with special abilities called Butterflies. For Maehwa Baek, Butterflies are just heroic people he sees on TV until a tragic event brings him to the scientists that created them. Soon, Maehwa must confront questions about himself that he has long avoided: why does he lose control at the sight of his own blood? And what happened during the 13 years of his life that he can’t remember?

(Source: WEBTOON)

132120.description:
Do-Won has a problem. His neighbor, Beom, seems awfully rude, but he’s infuriatingly gorgeous. And the completely ridiculous cherry on top? Beom turns out to be Do-Won’s all-time favorite camboy, which only adds to the (sexual) frustration. Beom is a metaphorical pain in Do-Won’s ass, and Do-Won would like to return the favor physically, thank you very much. So, Do-Won has a problem—in his pants. The question is, how is he going to solve it? You’ll find out the answer if you crank the volume up, and watch very, very closely…

(Source: Lezhin)
synonyms: I can hear it without a microphone
フルボリューム！~マイクなしでも聞こえる~

title.native: 夢美センパイは夢見がち。

132122.description: Alice Kinari, a girl just in primary school, seems to have a picture-perfect family. Her dad’s a hard worker, and her mom still has her gorgeous looks. All of that changes when an unexpected visitor appears, having Alice and her mom clasping each other’s hands in a grueling situation.

132123.description:
“Ugh! Life’s been miserable ever since that one stupid kiss! I NEVER should've done that! 'You wanna try?' she asked—It’s all her fault, and now she’s ignoring me! I can’t stop thinking about her!!!" Poor, unfortunate Ji-Won, stuck in a hormonal, teen game of cat and mouse. Kissed by her best friend, she’s left to her own devices to figure out what the hell is going on. Watch as cat turns to mouse, mouse to cat, and see how two childhood friends tiptoe the boundaries of their relationship.

(Source: Tapas, edited)
synonyms: ไกด์ไลน์ไกด์รัก

title.native: 小学生博徒〜青天井カケルの一日〜
title.romaji: Shougakusei Bakuto: Aotenjou Kakeru no Tsuitachi

132127.description:
I tried so hard to graduate from college. Now you are telling me that i have to relive my high school life! And do everything all over?! Heavy homework, a lover that doesn't love me, troublesome puberty... Hey, leave that boy alone, I'm his real wife!!!

(Source: WeComics)

132128.description:
Aiden was a normal, albeit glitched, NPC trying to make ends meet to support his sister when suddenly, the all-powerful system administrator appeared and deleted his whole town during routine maintenance. Due to his particular glitch, Aiden instead gains the power of an administrator... but it's too little too late, as his sister slowly fades into nothing in his arms. With his new administrator update abilities, Aiden swears to get revenge on the unseen overlords of his world. He'll stop NPC’s from ever being deleted again!

(Source: Tapas)

132129.description:
Young Master Motoi lost his mother at a young age, just after Sumiya, a butler to the Nikaido Family, had been assigned to care for the Young Master. As a result, Young Master Motoi becomes attached to Sumiya and eventually asks him to wear a maid's dress. Sumiya kindly complies with the Young Master's wishes up until Motoi is sent to boarding school. The first few days were hard for Sumiya, and then those days turned to weeks, then months, and after seven years apart, Young Master Motoi comes back, but he is definitely not as ""Young"" as he used to be! What will come of Young Master Motoi's homecoming? Will the Master/Servant pair be as attached to the hip as they once were... or more?

(Source: Futekiya)

title.native: ディア マイ ボーイ

132133.description:
Koya is the only son of the circus ringmaster. Growing up has proved difficult for him since he always got bullied for being a child of the circus, making him an introvert and labeled 'boring' by his peers. Now grown-up, he tries to land a decent job that does not involve the circus, with little luck. Having no other options, Koya decides to work in the circus, with his dad being the current owner, as both assistant and janitor. There he meets the fellow workers, including the dazzling, though loud mouthed Suzuki, who too gets on Koya's nerves from day one. Adding to that, it seems that the circus has budding relationships all around. But there is a slight problem: the circus has a love ban!

(Source: Futekiya)

132134.description:
Cornered in the belly of a tank... Raven wants to die with Amber in his arms. Raised in an orphanage, Raven fell in love with the "big brother" of the group, Amber, before striking out on his own. He would enlist in the army, only to be reunited with the man who, over the years, literally filled his dreams. He didn't want to see him there... The possibility of witnessing Amber's death begins to haunt him. Meanwhile, Amber looks out for Raven the way he always did, like a brother. He'll never see them as romantic partners... The two get caught in a firefight and embrace...!! A younger lone wolf and a muscular gentle giant, reunited and it feels so good!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ハザードライン・ファック

132135.description:
As he enjoys the days of his normal youth, Touji Kiyoteru starts living at the house of his late grandmother, who had mysterious powers. Then, among the mess inside, he finds a blood pact that this grandmother used to summon a demon familiar! All of a sudden, a butt naked demon appears and says he's hungry. As he starts sucking mana out, Kiyoteru gets horny...?! Wait... why am I getting turned on by this demon?! This demon's seducing me with his naked body, and I can't control myself! Why is it that whenever I see him, I want to tease him?! Grr... I'm going to fill you up with my mana! Kiyoteru is a super sadist, while the demon is a super masochist... don't miss this super-erotic, magical BL series!

(Source: Renta!)

132136.description:
After the death of his father Taizan, his son Taidake takes over the clinic in Nasu, where there is a visitor with a new story to tell.

Taidake, who like his father has a weakness for beautiful women, tries to help her, but she mentions an unexpected name...

132137.description: The cheerful monk, Butsugaku, teaches the history of Buddhism and the precepts upon which the religion was founded. Learn about the life of the historical Buddha and the era in which he lived, his mission to help people understand the importance of walking the Middle Way in life to avoid the extremes that contribute to human misery, and his Noble Eightfold Path that leads to wisdom and enlightenment.

title.native: ブッダのことばスッタニパータ

132139.description:
Haru Miyoshi, a researcher who loves his "alone time," agrees to a blind date just before his 30th birthday. However, his date's younger brother, Kei Akiyoshi, is there to greet him instead. Knowing that his sister stood Haru up, Kei is nice enough to join him for a few drinks. Comforted by Kei's kindness, a drunken Haru admits he's tormented by the urban legend that says "men who don't do it by their 30th birthday become wizards," when Kei leans in and steals his first kiss...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: 魔法使いカウントダウン
最高の二次元嫁とつきあう方法
title.romaji: Saiko no Nijigen Yome to Masaru au Hoho.

132142.description:
Chitose Aoyagi is a returnee from France. At his new school, he's reunited with Tasuke Akayuge, his childhood nemesis... a traumatic trigger he wishes he'd never have to deal with again! Why traumatic, you ask? In 4th grade, Tasuke not only stole the coveted Gad Red role in the school play, but he was the pervert who stole Chitose's first kiss! In Chitose's mind, "he's not 'Red' at all!" But, Tasuke quickly becomes popular and even gets chummy with Chitose's best friend, then professes his feelings for Chitose and does dirty things to him! Chitose feels all mixed up and doesn't know what to do...!

(Source: Renta!)

title.native: ぼくのトラウマレッド
となりの彼女と夜ふかしごはん
title.romaji: Tonari no Kanojo to Yofukashi Gohan

132144.description:
When Cheong-Myeong of the Mount Hua Sect awakens a hundred years in the future, his last memories are of a bloody battle against the Leader of the Demonic Cult, the evil Cheon-Ma. The battle almost saw the end of the Ten Great Sects of ancient China, when Cheong-Myeong ended the hard-fought struggle by striking down Cheon-Ma. Soon after, he succumbed to his wounds, filled with regret at their pyrrhic victory. All is not lost, however, as he awakens to his second chance at life. Shocked to find his beloved Mount Hua Sect reduced to a mere shadow of itself in the present day, Cheong-Myeong embarks on a journey to restore Mount Hua to its former glory.

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)
synonyms: Return of The Mount Hua Sect
Return of the Flowery Mountain Sect
หวนคืนสู่ฮวาซาน

132145.description:
Yu Ziyou and Zhong Wan pledged allegiance to different sovereigns. Both of them were talented people who appreciated each other yet had clashed openly and covertly before. After losing the fight for the throne, Zhong Wan brought his two young masters with him to the distant frontier. For the sake of survival, he relied on that bit of friendship that existed between him and Yu Ziyou when they were young. He borrowed some of his personal belongings while also dropping various hints which made everyone think that there was something intimate going on between them. Given the Yu Clan's powerful authoritative presence in the imperial court, this layer of relationship allowed Zhong Wan to live a much better life than before indeed. In addition, the stories he cooked up began to seem more and more realistic. As rumors of their lovely romance spread a thousand miles into the horizon, Yu Ziyou, who was located in the distant capital city, eventually caught wind of his deeply moving and epic love affair. Having been completely brainwashed for seven years, Yu Ziyou fell into a trance and believed the stories. It seemed like something special really did happen between them back in those years…

(Source: Bilibili Comics)
synonyms: Those Years In Quest Of Honour Mine

title.english: Those Years In Quest Of Honour Mine

132146.description:
Asahi Hiiragi suggests helping Uzuki to get over her extremely shy personality. Uzuki gets painfully embarrassed. She works as cleaning staff because it doesn't require her to talk to people. One day, Asahi asks her to dinner and he confesses his feelings to her. He's an employee at a security company. He's tall and big, doesn't show much emotion; he's a little scary... She starts to feel a little comfortable around him when she sees he's patient with her when it takes her time to talk. Still, she's a little unsure, so he suggests a "trial period" to date him. He wants to help her get over her fears and starts to take his shirt off, showing his well-built body...! A sincere, poker-faced gentleman and a very shy girl. A sweet story between two unlikely people!

(Source: Coolmic)

title.native: whisper&mellow -ウィスパーアンドメロウ-

132147.description:
After being dumped by her boyfriend of 3 years because she was "too responsible", Nanae began meeting up with men from dating apps. Sometimes they'd just have dinner, but sometimes, they'd go elsewhere for "dessert". No matter what she did, nothing would fill the void. One day during a sudden downpour, she stops in the convenience store and reaches for the same last umbrella as a hot younger guy! Nanae knows she needs to give up the apps, but she goes back hoping to meet a guy just as hot as him. That weekend, the man who shows up to their date is him...!

(Source: Renta!)

132204.description:
Nazuna Saito began making comics late. She was in her forties when she submitted a story to a major Japanese publishing house and won an award for newcomers. She continued to work through the 1990s until she stopped drawing to take care of her ailing parents. In her sixties, she took a job teaching drawing at Kyoto Seika University and became inspired by her talented students. When she returned to teaching, her storytelling interests had shifted. Before suffering a stroke she drew “In Captivity” (2012) and “Solitary Death Building” (2015)—both focused on aging and death. Offshore Lightning collects Saito’s early work as well as these two recent graphic novellas.

Stories like “Buy Dog Food and Go Home” and “Offshore Lightning” focus on middle-aged men caught in a cycle of self pity and self reflection. Saito gently pokes fun at their anguish and self-involvement while capturing the pathos of these men as they revisit childhood friendships and lost loves. By contrast, “In Captivity” follows three siblings visiting their ailing mother who is succumbing to dementia and resentful at her loss of agency. The siblings take a drive as they reckon with balancing the painful legacy of her caustic personality with attempting to honor this woman at the end of her life. “Solitary Death Building” documents an eccentric cast of elderly gossips as death descends upon the housing complex where they all live..

132266.description:
Jin-Ju is bad. She smokes, drinks, runs away from home, and has no qualms making her parents worry. Her mother and sister beg her to be a better student, sister, daughter; her beleaguered father expresses his concerns with his fists. Bad Friends is set in the 1990s in a South Korea torn between tradition and Western modernity and haunted by an air of generalized gloom. Cycles of abuse abound as the characters enact violence within their power structures: parents beat children, teachers beat students, older students beat younger students. But at each moment the duress verges on bleakness, Ancco pulls back with soft moments of friendship between Jin-Ju and her best friend, Jeong-Ae. What unfolds is a story of female friendship, a Ferrante-esque connection formed through youthful excess, malaise, and struggle that stays with the young women into adulthood.

Served by a dry and precise line, Bad Friends viscerally captures the adolescent years of two young women who want and know they deserve something different, but, ultimately, are unable to follow through. In a culture where young women are at a systemic disadvantage, Ancco creates a testimonial to female friendship as a powerful tool for survival. Jin-Ju forgets her worst adolescent memories, but she cannot ever shake the memory of her friendship with Jeong-Ae during her most tumultuous years.

(Source: Drawn & Quarterly, edited)

Akane is driven to despair in her life of poverty, and Reika is sick of being confined by her family. These two look-a-likes decide to switch places! Akane finds herself in a huge mansion surrounded by Reika's doting husband who has a mother complex, and his younger brothers who have their own agendas. Reika befriends a photographer called Kumada, and ends up approaching him with a need...?! This is a story of these two beauties, love and desire, and their lust for the impossible!

(Source: Media Do International/Jitsugyo no Nihon Sha)

132334.description: A forbidden secret romance between a young girl dressed as a man x a houseboy in depravity. Due to various reasons, Ren has to live under a fake surname. One day, a mysterious young man appears before her…

title.native: 少年ブラヰド ―男装令嬢と黒書生―
title.romaji: Shounen Bride: Dansou Reijou to Kuro Shosei

132335.description:
"I'm going to confess my love to you tomorrow!"

Imada, a normal high school student, becomes friends with his classmate Urashima and falls in love with him. Imada decides to confess his feelings for Urashima in order to get out of his tedious one-sided love. This is a story of misunderstanding and first love that is both sad and frustrating.

(Source: Libre Shuppan, translation)

遊☆戯☆王SEVENS ルーク!爆裂覇道伝!!

132349.description:
Natsumi Eguchi took us to the afterlife with Hozuki’s Coolheadedness. Now, they take us somewhere even stranger: the land of the living. College students Magi and Yaeko’s lives take a strange turn the day a man is struck on the head by a falling dictionary from the sky. Bleeding, dazed, and refusing help from the police or paramedics, he sets off every alarm in their minds. But the real shock comes after. Ever since that chance encounter, the world around them has started to shift. Ghosts. Spirits. Unexplainable things. Whatever this man is, he’s opened their eyes to a realm that was never meant to be seen—and a story that was never meant to be told.

(Source: K MANGA)

title.english: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole

title.native: 神風おにいさんといっしょ。

132353.description: During a time of chaos, superheroes appeared, and the world became peaceful once again. Two brothers who admired the so-called "Earth’s saviors" vowed to become heroes together, but in that world, people are categorized into groups of "Heroes" that protect, and "Mobs" who clean up the mess after. The younger brother Hiiro is a "Mob", while the older Ao is a "Hero". However in times of crisis, especially if their childhood friend Iruka is involved, Hiiro will jump into danger without hesitation!

132354.description:
After quitting baseball because of a certain incident, Tetsuji has been spending his high school days listlessly until one day, his married elder sister suddenly returned home.

She's 188cm tall and he's too scared to ask of her weight. Her name's Mao and her nickname is Maou a.k.a Demon King.

Tetsu is also big-sized but he is timid unlike his sister who is huge in many ways, and they are about to spend an unexpectedly sad yet fiery summer holiday together.

132358.description:
Set during the historic Edo period, the story centers on the titular Fujieda Baian, a medicine man and doctor by day, but ruthless killer for hire by night. His tools of the trade are the same in either job: acupuncture needles that leave no trace.

(Source: Anime News Network)

132359.description:
Fairytale stepmothers are notoriously wicked. But after a children’s clothing designer is reborn as young Princess Blanche’s stepmom, she’s determined to break the mold and shower her daughter with love. Now she just has to convince the girl’s cold-hearted father to do the same. In her quest to make a happier home for Blanche, Abigail begins to uncover secrets and schemes within the palace. Will devious forces tear the Freidkins apart, or can Abigail stitch them back into a family?

(Source: Tapas)

I'm the Stepmother, but My Daughter Is Too Cute
Solo soy una madrastra, ¡pero mi hija es tan linda!
I'm Only a Stepmother, but My Daughter Is Just so Cute!
ฉันเป็นแม่เลี้ยงนะ แต่ลูกสาวน่ารักเกินไปแล้ว

132360.description:
Yuri Takizawa, the most popular girl at school, has mysteriously disappeared... To find clues to her disappearance, the homeroom teacher Tsukishima gathers her best friend Tomoe Aida, her childhood friend Toru Himuro, and Hiroto Watanabe, who confessed to Yuri on the day of the incident, in his classroom to find out what happened. But...! This is a romantic mystery that reveals the truth of the case from various perspectives!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: シンデレラは6月に消えた

132361.description:
Asugure General Hospital has an "in-house security department," which is rather uncommon in Japan. Kawamoto is hired as a clerical worker for the security office, which deals with patient disputes, complaints against doctors, and other accusations like improper treatment and medical malpractice.

The story also features Murai Osamu, the chief detective, and Sakakibara Shunsuke, a genius surgeon who recently returned to Japan from overseas.

A full-fledged medical x detective mystery! The two professionals will expose the "sickness" and "darkness" that lurks within the halls of the hospital.

(Source: Young Champion Web, trnslated)

title.native: 院内警察～アスクレピオスの蛇～

132362.description:
The new guy at Yuzuka's part-time job is Kurosawa-kun, a boy her age who goes to an all-boys school. She feels like he's staring at her all the time, but when she tries to talk to him, he gets very shy.

"Maybe he likes me...?"

When she looks at him more closely, she notices that he's actually quite handsome and just her type.... Oh no, the realization is making her blush self-consciously!　 When she boldly asks Kurosawa-kun about his feelings, he denies everything, saying "I don't even like you, don't be conceited...!"

A girl from a co-ed school meets a boy from an all-boys school who is not used to girls.
The boy's shy face makes her want to squeal... as she gets swept away by his tsundere act!
A real youthful love story!

(Source: Betsufure, translated)

title.native: 照れて、見つめて、恋をして
婚約者さまから逃げられない

132364.description:
Sachi and her boyfriend Takara are a young couple in high school. They go to school together, hang out, and even engage in the more intimate side of dating. However, after a recent evening of sex, Sachi gets the feeling that something isn’t right and buys a pregnancy test. Later, in the bathroom of a family restaurant far from her home, she sees the two red lines that will change her life forever.

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

132365.description:
I was reincarnated... Into a world where you die if no one loves you!? A fantasy world romance between an infatuated bachelor and a lonely boy!

(Source: Coolmic)

Note: Includes two extra chapters.

title.english: A Near-Death Experience Is a Cry for Love
title.native: 死にぞこないは愛に啼く

132366.description:
Saint Lily shared the voice of the goddess Seraph and guided the empire… until the goddess stopped talking to her, the empire fell, and she died. But when Seraph grants her another chance at life, Lily takes her destiny in a different direction. Now the leader of a gang, she’s focused on making the empire hers, with a little bit of kidnapping and dating tossed in! After making the switch from saint to villainess, will Lily finally find happiness? Or will she discover there’s more to life than good and evil?

(Source: Tapas)
synonyms: ลิลลี่ นักบุญสุดโหด

132367.description:
In the Kingdom of Jasmine, there lives a blacksmith named Anna Baker. Anna is highly skilled at making swords, and her work is much sought after - even the dashing Prince Alexander is a regular customer. One day, the Prince comes by the forge to pick up his new sword, but leaves the sheath behind! Anxious to find him, Anna hurries out into the deep, dark forest in pursuit… and that’s where her adventures begin!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title.native: ストレンジ・ロジック　鬼の見る夢
title.romaji: Strange Logic: Oni no Miru Yume

132369.description:
Tsukasa, a reserved and effeminate boy enrolls in St. Trea High School where his cousin Mahiro works as a teacher. As St. Trea was a girls' school until recently, Tsukasa is one of few male students and has not been able to make any friends. While eating a lunch prepared by his stepsister Hazakura alone in the schoolyard, he encounters a beautiful dusky girl saving a kitten from a tree. Fascinated by her, Tsukasa learns she is a foreign princess named Siris and decides to become stronger. Mahiro and Hazakura recommend he try the new VRMMO, Princess Heart Link, where a player's desires are amplified to break through inhibitions they face in reality.

There Tsukasa encounters Siris under attack by a hacker. Despite her superior skills, she is at an obvious disadvantage until Tsukasa instinctively dives in to save her. Using that moment of distraction to gain the upper hand, Siris defeats the hacker and is captivated by Tsukasa's manly actions. In thanks, she rewards him with a special service.

The pair then agree to an [Engage Link]--an in-game marriage, when a bug suddenly occurs that transmits pleasure shared through the link into reality...

(Source: Paradigm, translated)

132373.description:
Wendy was taken back to the palace by the king of Babylon... However, she doesn't want to spend an extra second with this tyrant of history! “I just want to go home!” Wendy began to fight back in this mysterious country of Babylon and the rumored tyrant...

(Source: Mangatoon)
synonyms: 暴君に囚われる王妃～私が身代わりで花嫁に!?

132374.description:
Yui is a humble, cute, and popular salesperson at a department store jewelry shop. There are countless men who have feelings for her, but there are secret rumours that at closing time a "knight" comes to see her off. Her "knight", an elite trading company employee, conceals his love for Yui for some reason, and watches over her as the closest person in her life. However, after the appearance of a certain male customer, this "knight" becomes her controlling, blindly infatuated boyfriend...? "It may be embarrassing, but I want to see all of you, Yui... Will you stay like this, and be mine, and mine alone?? She melts for her childhood friend turned lover... Why? Even though it's a little scary, why is it she wants it even harder...!?

(Source: Renta!)

Note: Chapter count includes two extras from the volume release.

Draw the game! Two major brands collaborate for a manga competition! Jump and top game publisher Ubisoft team up for a new manga competition! Four of Ubisoft's biggest games: Assassin's Creed, Watch Dogs, The Division and Far Cry are used as source material. Here are the 5 award-winning works!

132377.description:
Wrench from Watch Dogs 2 has fallen in love with a woman who works at the donut shop! He's too shy to even ask for her number, despite Marcus's advice, but suddenly...

(Source: Shueisha, translated)

132378.description:
Monica promised her childhood friend Leon that she would marry him if he became the best gunfighter in the West. Their marriage goes off without a hitch, but on their wedding night, when they were supposed to be at the height of their happiness, Leon tells her he wants a divorce. What is the cause of the complication and what will happen to them in this lighthearted romantic comedy?

(Source: Shonen Jump Plus, translated)
synonyms: The Best Bride in the West

132379.description:
The May issue of Akita Shoten's Bessatsu Shounen Champion magazine revealed on Monday that Spanish artist Kenny Ruiz (Telémaco, Dos Espadas) will launch a new manga in collaboration with Tezuka Productions based on various characters of Osamu Tezuka's manga.

In the manga's story, a robot alliance rules over 90% of the universe. The knight Sapphire is troubled over the pain of non-robots, and she makes a decision, for a new future.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.native: チーム・フェニックス

132380.description:
"You're burning hot inside... squeezing my fingers so tight."

Unknown pleasures spread through my body as he relentlessly assaults me with a beastly look I'd never seen before...My childhood friend and housemate, Nao, has turned in a marriage form without the other's agreement... Wait, that's me!? I'm forced to live as a married couple when I've never seen him as "man" before... Moreover, now that he's my husband, he starts touching me saying.

"I'll make you fall for me!"

He's doing things backwards. Don't tell me that he's gonna steal away my first time, too!?

(Source: Coolmic)

132384.description:
After the death of China's first emperor, Shi Huang, Liu Bang fought with the demon god of war, Kuang Yu, to become the founder of the Han Dynasty. The story of Liu Bang, the founder of the Han Dynasty, depicts the extraordinary fate of a man who rose from a peasant to become emperor, and the human drama that surrounds him.

(From Shogakukan, translated)

title.native: 私が大好きな小説家を殺すまで
title.romaji: Watashi ga Daisuki na Shousetsuka wo Korosu made

132388.description:
The summer sun is getting harder and harder to bear every year, the winter mountains are getting colder and colder, and the threat of a new virus is creeping up on us. And yet, the deadline has come again this month!
While living a self-restrained life in the mountains of Izu, a state of emergency is always declared!

(From Kadokawa, translated)

This 2021 entry in the Izu Mantama series includes 4koma published in the weekly Famitsu between 2018/7/5 and 2020/12/24, and chapters published in Comic Beam between 2019/1/12 and 2020/9/12

132389.description:
Tamakichi Sakura's long-awaited short comic collection! Life in the mountains of Izu is tough and interesting!

A wandering manga artist, Tamakichi Sakura, leaves the manga cafe where he has lived for a long time and moves to the mountains of Izu! This was the start of his daily struggle against nature!

This is the 2017 entry of the Izu Mantama series. It includes entries published between 2014 and 2015 : in the Comic Beam (non 4-koma entries) and in the Weekly Famitsu (for 4-koma entries).

(From Kadokawa, translated)

title.native: アルマゲドンにダマされる!!

132394.description: Spaceship "Kinjo" lands on the Moon, carrying classified intel. After all contact with the ship and its crew is lost due to the spread of a mysterious biofluid, it's up to the last master swordsman left alive, Tomura Tadamitsu, to retrieve the ship's cargo.

132396.description:
The sickly Sect Master Yun Yifeng peddles intelligence, and Prince Xiao requires his service to investigate a theft. Enticing Yun with medicine that can cure his sickness—something Prince Xiao doesn't have—the two embark on a journey to investigate the theft. Something blossoms beyond friendship along the way.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

Note: Chapter count includes an extra.

title.english: A Single Strike Of Shimmering Frost

132397.description:
Mitsui, a typical high schooler, is part of a vigilante group going by the name "Spinner Bait," disguising itself as an ordinary fishing club. The order of hierarchy within the group is based on points earned by cracking down on crime, what will happen to Mitsui, who has yet to earn a single point.

(Source: Gentosha, translated)

132398.description:
In an era when vampires and humans coexist, having one's blood sucked by a smart and beautiful night walker is considered a status symbol. Shion's tired of sucking the blood of stuck-up women. One night, he runs into and becomes infatuated with Hajime, an average-looking office worker who smells delicious. Hajime, however, is a glutton for punishment, and wants the arrogant Shion to treat him like a slave in exchange for his blood. Shion reluctantly agrees... He hates it, but the pleasure is too much to resist. Will Hajime end up going to town on his cute new master!? This is a love story between a depraved human and a pushy vampire.

(Source : Renta!)

title.english: Do As Your Slave Tells You
title.native: 下僕さまの言うとおり

132399.description: Cain, a boy with a mysterious 'Voice' power, travels the Black Spot in the hopes of uncovering the past of a girl with no memories.

132400.description:
The ocean covers about 70 percent of the earth's surface—a whole world, yet unknown to humanity… And in its depths, a nation, thousands of meters beneath the waves. There, the mermaid Jo has been whiling away her days in peace. But that tranquility is shattered when her friend Ryuu is locked away for breaking the gravest of undersea laws: that humans must never know of the world below.

But why would Ryuu let the secret slip? And who did she tell? The curtain rises on Jo's adventure to save her friend—and on her love..!?

(Source: Yen Press)

title.english: A Sinner of the Deep Sea
title.native: アビスアジュールの罪人

132401.description:
Mayu Sugino's an office worker who loves sweets. She's secretly dating her coworker, Ryo Fujii, who hides his sweet tooth at the office. A trip to the beach is planned as a staff outing, which means bathing suits are a must. Ryo suggests a very special workout regimen to lose weight: Kissing! Doing it from behind!! On top!!! Will all of this physical activity get Mayu the results she's after...!?

(Source: Renta!)

title.english: A Chubby Girlfriend and Her Sweet-Toothed Boyfriend -Soft, Syrupy Exercise With You-
title.native: ぽっちゃり彼女とスイーツ彼氏　アナタとトロあまセクササイズ
title.romaji: Pocchari Kanojo to Sweets Kareshi: Anata to Toroama Sexercise

132402.description: One of the first science-fiction manga, Kasei Tanken is a story of an expedition to Mars by Tentaro with his cat Nyanko and his dog Pichi.

132403.description:
Seo Hyunsoo is sure of one thing: people are scum and they will always disappoint you. Sure enough, at his very first company dinner after his transfer to a new department, he finds his coworker, the obnoxiously upbeat Baek Youngchan, performing an unsavory deed in the men's bathroom. As much as Hyunsoo would like to avoid Youngchan from that point on, Youngchan seems intent on not letting him out of his sight... Will Hyunsoo be able to evade the encroaching chaos of his new work neighbor? Or will these two clashing coworkers find that opposites really do attract?

(Source: Tappytoon)

Note: Includes 15 extra chapters.

異世界の底辺料理人は絶頂調味料で成り上がる！ ～魔王攻略の鍵は人造精霊少女たちとの秘密の交わり!?～

132409.description: Miwa Kubota is a 29-year old movie fanatic who just got fired from her dead-end job. She notices that her favorite actor, the world-renowned Takashi Yatsumi, is looking for a housekeeper. Even though she is totally unqualified, she goes there anyway. When she sees the new hire get into an accident outside his door, Miwa steps in to become the "pretend" housekeeper for her idol.

synonyms: Annoying (Step) Sister Needs to be Scolded!!

132414.description:
Graffiti. It’s the magic of ephemeral visuals that vividly overwrite even her and my thoughts―

Yoshi, a university student studying abroad in Bristol, Britain, uncovers graffiti at his workplace. Together with his colleague Boudicia, a languid but wild girl with golden hair, he uncovers a secret world of graffiti he never knew existed, as he is dragged into the conflict between graffiti writers and police, all the while struggling to rekindle his passion for music after a traumatic event.

synonyms: The Greatest Demon King in the Other World

title.romaji: Isekai Saikyou no Daimaou, Tensei shi Boukensha ni Naru

title.native: ニューワールドオーダー

132421.description: Anita, a lonely assassin, found herself staring the Grim Reaper in the face. But if she can fend him off for four minutes, she will be spared death, this time.

132422.description:

2. Romanchikku de Nemurenai (ロマンチックでねむれない)
3. Itsuka Ouji-sama ga (いつか王子様が)

132423.description: UFO, flying saucers, I wonder if they do exist? What about Nessie? The Abominable Snowman? Ghosts…? They may exist or they may not. Our world still has mysteries that cannot be explained by modern science, and people can often attribute supernatural nature for things that they can’t understand. But what if there’s a parallel world where all that can be real? There are those who believe in the existence of multiple worlds, at least in theory. It’s not possible to tell for sure, but in the world of this manga, they do exist.

132425.description:
After being outed by his first love in high school, Juho has been struggling in his romantic endeavors ever since. One evening after a distasteful phone call with a cheating ex, Juho sees someone has been staring at him. Juho recognizes Kang Jaemin, an old high school classmate. Juho and Jaemin briefly catch up on each other's lives when Juho makes a surprising offer for Jaemin to stay the night at his place to which Jaemin agrees.

(Source: Pocket Comics)

Note: Includes eight extra chapters.

132426.description: Suddenly the waterfall mirage that appeared in front of me... Rika, a high school girl who was sucked into it, lost herself to another world and was saved by Takaya when she was about to be killed by the Zaba tribe. Takaya was also lost 10 years ago... When the mirage appears, can you return to the original world?

10月31日、ハロウィン、私はシブヤで人生捨てました。
title.romaji: 10-gatsu 31-nichi, Halloween, Watashi wa Shibuya de Jinsei Sutemashita.

132431.description:
Toa needed some extra spending money, and a friend has the hook up on a sweet new job! It starts as a simple hostess gig, but when one customer is willing to shell out some big bucks for some hotel action, Toa's eyes light up. With the acts getting more extreme with each new sugar daddy, the lines are blurring on what she loves more—the moolah or the dick!

(Source: Fakku!)

132433.description:
Fukufuku Banpukuchou is a story about a small god, Mamefuku, who sends good fortune to those who are virtuous. In the first story, Mamefuku appears to a girl who has broken a vase of flowers that her mother cherishes.

132581.description:
Lee Soyeon, Myeong-ok, and Yeonjeong are all mothers in their mid-fifties. And they’ve had it. They can no longer bear the dead weight of their partners or the endless grind of menial jobs where their bosses control everything, down to how much water they can drink. Although Lee Soyeon divorced her husband years ago after his gambling drove their family into bankruptcy, she’s found herself in another tired and dishonest decade-long relationship with Jongseok, a slimy waiter at a nightclub. Meanwhile, Myeong-ok is having an illicit affair with a younger man, and Yeonjeong, whose husband suffers from erectile dysfunction, has her eye on an acquaintance from the gym.

Bored with conventional romantic dalliances, these women embrace outrageous sexual adventures and mishaps, ending up in nightclubs, motels, and even the occasional back-alley brawl.

With this boisterous and darkly funny manhwa, Yeong-shin Ma defies the norms of the traditional Korean family narrative, offering instead the refreshingly honest and unfiltered story of a group of middle-aged moms who yearn for something more than what the mediocre men in their lives can provide. Despite their less than desirable jobs, salaries, husbands, and boyfriends, these women brazenly bulldoze their way through life with the sexual vulnerability and lust typically attributed to twenty-somethings.

132681.description:
At nineteen, the idea that you have your whole life ahead of you with endless possibilities can leave you terrifyingly stiff. Throwing mobility to the wind, you dull yourself with booze. The grownups around you are stunted by their own failures so they act out—with alcohol, too, sometimes with violence. What was once the hope of youth quickly spirals into powerlessness and malaise as the days trickle by you. Ancco expertly renders the moment of suspension between the desire to grow up and the fear that accompanies it.

Autobiography blends with fiction in these coming-of-age stories about people reckoning with their place in their community and women coming to terms with other women. A boy living with HIV tries to decide how he’s going to tell his parents—or whether he should tell them at all. A mother puts pressure on her daughter to pass her exams, and the stress of it all drives them both to drink, fueling a toxic relationship with a lot of care just below the ugly surface. Another girl keeps getting bruises, but who’s inflicting the damage—herself or a loved one? And dogs—seemingly the only ones capable of unconditional love-—offer some reprieve.

Ancco delivers a cutting panorama of contemporary Korean society that’s much darker than one might expect, while also brimming with life and the vitality of youth.

To cope, he finds himself reminiscing about their family meals together, particularly his mother's kimchi, a traditional dish that is prepared by the family and requires months of fermentation. Memories of his mother's glorious cooking―so good it would prompt a young Madang and his brother into song―soothe the family. With her impending death, Madang races to learn her recipes and bring together the three generations at the family table while it's still possible. After a catastrophic falling out, professional E-sports competitors Shi Luo and Yu Sui parted ways. Shi Luo knows better than to open himself up to the man who broke his heart but, when that man approaches him with a proposal for a new team, familiar feelings begin to bubble up to the surface.

(Source: Tapas)

The teacher I love so much is stroking my sensitive place with oil... making such lewd noises. It's embarrassing... but I can't help but move my hips wanting more!

132862.description:
Konoha is a wild fox that has fallen in love with Mizuno, a convenient store worker. Wanting to get closer to him, she transforms into a human (with a tail), just to do it for her loved one. Although, it makes Kureha, her best friend became worried of her...?

Note: Includes the one shots Kaguya to Takeru (INARI君の弓道) and INARI-kun no Kyuudou (INARI君の弓道).

132863.description:
Yosuke Ejima was gravely injured in a bus hijacking incident involving the mafia. He inherited the power of the Aztec priests to “rip hearts out” and resurrected as a special A-class assassin. By using this power, Yosuke took his beloved wife back from the mafia and should have been living a happy life, but...?!

Office worker Momose keeps his being an otaku a secret and tries to lead his daily life as inconspicuously as possible. As his new colleague Sadamura is introduced to him one day, he is in for the shock of a lifetime: Sadamura had been the boy who protected him from being bullied by other children, but wanted Momose to be his "dog" that did everything for him in exchange! Just as Momose is racking his brain on how to deal with this unwelcome reunion, both of them are put in the same group for a project!

Note: Contains a side story.

132865.description:
Amelia is an admirer of the Marquise Sophie, content to be an inconspicuous member of Sophie's entourage. One day, Amelia saw Sophie's fiancee, the crown prince, secretly meeting with the Baroness Rosetta.

"If I harass Rosetta and force her away from the prince, will that make the prince look at me again?" Sophie asked.

No, that will just make Sophie become the villainess! In order to keep her precious Sophie away from the bad ending, Amelia will have to help her with the ways of love! But that draws the attention of Sophie's tsundere brother Rufus...!?

(Source: ComicWalker, translated)

Heesuh hates Jinmoo, always has and always will. However, his plan to destroy Jinmoo’s life flops because instead of humiliating Jinmoo, the pair spends a passionate night together. Jinmoo wants to take responsibility for his drunk actions, and Heesuh is definitely only dating him for another shot at revenge because there is no way Heesuh is falling for his sexy, sexy enemy.

Naruse, a high school teacher, has a beautiful girlfriend who is a manga artist by profession. They have been seriously dating for about two years, but even after all that time, he doesn't even know what kind of manga she draws. On the other hand, Ondeko, who is attracted to how Naruse looks with glasses, has a secret that she has not yet told Naruse...?

132877.description:
The sudden crisis brought the earth directly into the OL era, and all mankind was under the influence of mysterious forces. Everyone became a level-one newbie. In this cruel dog-eat-dog world, the high school student Ye Hao could only rise to level three. When he was about to die, he accidentally triggered the king's account upgrade system, can Ye Hao become the strongest king?

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

There is a King Account at the Start
Start to Have the King Account

Amidst a world of monks and demons, good and evil, an ancient poltergeist and a young priest seek to repair a seal he accidentally broke. On the adventure to find the way of sealing, they will be constantly challenge the line between good and evil.

(Source: AC.QQ, translated)

132880.description: Chiya takes on a new job tailoring the costumes of an actor who specializes in playing bad guys. She is attracted by his cute smile and dependability in private despite his fierce public reputation... Even if it's her first time, she's not afraid of you!

132881.description:
She had remade herself from a tomboy into a goddess. But an unfortunate encounter with the delinquent boy ruined her reputation. His bold outfits and constant flirting makes him seem like a bad guy, but in reality his intentions are pure and honest. Slowly her dislike turn into love... Have you ever liked bad boys?

(Source: Kuaikan Manhua, translated)

132882.description:
Ranju has had a massive crush on Jiha, the school’s most popular girl, with her angelic beauty and kind nature. But when Ranju hears the shocking news that Jiha is going on a group date, she’s thrown into a panic. Determined not to let her chance slip away, Ranju hatches a bold plan to win Jiha’s heart before anyone else can. Will Ranju’s daring moves lead to the romance of her dreams, or will she get stopped on her way to the finish line?

(Source: Lezhin US)

132888.description:
Yuer Le is determined to investigate the mysterious disappearance of her best friends from two years ago. She enters a casino to find the heir of a noble family, her prime suspect. However, she is unexpectedly forced to dance for him, and this leads her into a more complicated scheme. The nature of friendship and love remains puzzling as she tries to unravel the conspiracy.

(Source: INKR)

132889.description: Chiyoko, in her second year of high school, transfers to a co-ed school due to her dad's job transfer. Since she's only attended an all-girls school since junior high, she excitedly plans to fall in love in her new school. Out of the blue, she begins to see the love meters of 5 hotties and an options window as if she were in an otome game?! She encounters various types such as a glasses boy, a playboy underclassman, and a mysterious senior. Meet-cutes with boys come one after another. This is the beginning of a real otome game school life!

132891.description:
Lee Jinhwa lived an ordinary life until she swallowed a fox bead gifted by a mysterious peddler, mistaking it for a wish-fulfilling marble. Little did Jinhwa know that her actions would lead her to be haunted by Koo Miho, an infamous nine-tailed fox who wishes to retrieve the bead. To add fuel to the fire, Jinhwa soon discovers that she's also become a target for various spirits and demons, and the only way to extract the cause of the issue is for Miho to kill her... or kiss her!

132895.description:
Detective Woojin Seo lives in an era where machines can prosecute criminals. Faced with Woojin’s murderous temper and obsession with bringing down the cartels, his supervisors place him under disciplinary probation and begin to rely on the machines to enact justice. But he’s given an opportunity to lift his suspension as an educational navigator to “Magnum,” a military-grade android, that people derogatorily refer to as “C.O.P.” or “Court of Puppet.” Will this unlikely pair have what it takes to defy the dark underbelly of this neon city?

(Source: Tapas)

title.native: やくならマグカップも

132898.description:
The never-before-told story of how young Leia Organa comes to join the rebellion against the evil Empire.

A young Princess Leia spends her days learning the ways of politics, aiding those in need and preparing for the traditional ceremony in which she declares her intention to one day rule Alderaan. But as Leia prepares herself to be named the heir of the throne, she becomes aware of the growing distance between her and her parents, who behind closed doors are leaders of the newly formed rebellion. Upon learning her parents' secrets, Leia must now make a choice between her responsibility to the people of Alderaan and her responsibility to save a galaxy crushed by the rule of the Empire.

(Source: Yen Press)

The manga is centered on the famous Heian-era poet and The Pillow Book author Sei Shounagon, and on court life in the Heian era.

(Source: Anime News Network, edited)

132900.description:
Ichito, a high school teacher, is supposed to be living together with his lover... but he walks in on his boyfriend having an affair! Suddenly, the mysterious man who helped him to his apartment is furious. In fact, the man is Ryugasaki, the other guy's boyfriend! The stunned Ichito is pushed down by Ryugasaki who says he must "take responsibility" and then he takes his virginity!!

Note: Chapter count includes 2 extras.

132906.description:
Born into a family of musicians, Gu Si is known as a musical genius, but never recognized by his father because of the lack of emotions in his music. In order to overcome this shortcoming, Gu Si began to study up on Charles, a musician who's known for showing an abundance of emotions in his works. Who would've thought that halfway into the book, he fell asleep and finds himself waking up 200 years back in the past. Is this expressionless man with rusty piano skills standing before my eyes really the legendary Charles?

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

132907.description:
I treated you like a brother, so how could you confess to me?! I only wanted to avoid you but I ended up hurting you through an accident. I’m sorry. If I had another chance, I definitely won't run away again. However… That chance came so fast. I suddenly traveled back three years ago and met you again. The you who doesn’t yet know me.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

132908.description:
Chi Su Mu's favourite hobby is feeding stray dogs and doing house chores. In a sudden incident of “Kleine-Levin syndrome”, he met the hot-tempered yet tsundere “fox”, Gu Xue. With his kind disposition, Sumu suddenly became an emergency member of “Whale Fall” and has to commit a vaccine robbery, thanks to Gu Xue. A complete noob in combat, he was somewhat molded into a versatile agent under Gu Xue’s training. After joining the organization, only then did Sumu know the shackles and mission of being a “sentinel and guide”. Sumu’s inclination and admiration towards Gu Xue when he first met him gradually turns into mutual feelings of attachment.

(Source: Bilibili Comics)

132909.description: Kotaro has an unrequited love with Aoyagi, an elite business man, who is a regular customer at the café he works at. To make matters worse, Kotaro takes home and collects Aoyagi’s used straws for masturbation material. He was satisfied just with the things Aoyagi touched, but what happens when his feelings finally reach Aoyagi?! However, for their distorted love to begin from being caught red-handed is… Follow a couple ridiculed with lies’ sick love! And in the second story, watch as a nerd loses his virginity to his childhood best friend, who is a model, in a case of a twisted, perverted love.

132910.description:
Printing shop employee Yoshifumi Arima is pursued each night by popular actor and movie star Ichito Mochizuki. "One of these days, I'll get off with only my..." Worried about when it'll happen, a new intern joins the Hanaoto Printing Shop. Noticing that the ice-cold newbie, Ryota Mine, only seems to be bonding with Yoshifumi, Ichito's imagination runs wild. "Those are bedroom eyes...!" Jealousy drives him to put the moves on Yoshifumi at work, leading to...! A lazy actor and a printshop employee! The fourth episode of the "Drawn" Series! Ozaki and Watanabe, the "adult" couple are back with bonus content.

At a reunion held to commemorate the closing of her old junior high school, Mio Imai (28), is reunited with her first love, Shuichi Amamiya. The formerly popular boy is now the president of an IT company, his star shining brighter than ever. Her best friend Nanae and other female classmates of “suitable age” all flock around him, and he invites them all to come have dinner with him…!? But on the day that Imai is suppose to meet Amemiya in Tokyo, Nanae is found in a very different state. Was it just an accident or…? No one knows what his true face is really like — which face will appear when the thin sheet separating good and evil is peeled away? An authentic romantic thriller!

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

132915.description:
The story takes place in Victorian London at the end of the 19th century, a city where opulence and decadence, light and dark, coexist. It follows the fates of two men: A police sergeant, nicknamed the King, and the Baron, a vampire. Their lives seem to be linked in strange ways.

Chako Hananoki thought she'd found happiness in a handsome fiancé, but when she realized a marriage to him would mean a total erasure of herself, she broke it off and moved back into her childhood home in the country... only to find a strange man and young woman living there? She finds a way to coexist with them, but when her stalker fiancé follows her home, she declares to him (and accidentally to the whole village as well) that this new man in her life is her husband?!

Isaac was kicked out of his girlfriend's house on a dark and cold night. Suddenly, a man who introduces himself as her brother appears in front of him. Nowhere else to go, Isaac has no choice but to... move in with him?! This guy, Seo-Jun, might be a little full of himself but he's also rich and good-looking. Everything about Seo-Jun seems just perfect. But then what could be the reason he's showing interest in Isaac?.

On his way back to his home planet, Pokomuu, the spaceship breaks down and Mumurin tries to take off in an emergency. He ends up in the room of Kota, a Japanese elementary school student.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

132925.description:
Eugene Misaki has the special ability to see other people's memories just by touching them. One day, a mysterious man named Hiroki Koshikano comes to Eugene, who has been using his ability to earn some money, and asks him if he can look into his memories. Eugene, who usually only uses his abilities on people he knows, refuses, but Hiroki insists that he will pay a reasonable amount.

(Source: Natalie, translated)

132926.description:
Yuki is a 20-year-old college sophomore who has wished for one thing since moving to Tokyo: to find her soulmate. Growing a bit desperate after a long drought, she goes along with a friend to a club for the first time. Her friend thrives, but it's chaotic and loud... just not Yuki's scene. Just when Yuki begins to despair that she'll never ever find a real, adult relationship, she meets Iori, a man with bleached hair and a slightly scary demeanor… but first impressions don't always tell the whole story. Could destiny still have more cards to play?

(Source: Kodansha USA)

132927.description: Kanata, a wealthy man who has returned to Japan for the first time in 8 years, was invited by some friends to visit a special members-only club. The staff there use a drug called "Berry" to imitate animals and entertain customers. The number one in the store is Ibuki, who mimics a rabbit. He gets caught by a persistent customer and has trouble dealing with him. Seeing this, Kanata decides to nominate Ibuki and takes him out of the store…

Hearing how his lightly-colored eyes match his lightly-colored nipples makes him nervous. Is his heart racing because of the alcohol...? Seichi Hasuki is a designer and single father whose son suggests he find a new wife. He tries going to singles' mixers, but he has a habit of fawning over how great his teenage boy is and ends up driving the ladies away. He's been unable to find the new love of his life. One day, though, at yet another mixer he spots Inukai, a young and successful man. The two hit it off and become quick pals... Seichi's been working his butt off trying to be a great dad, but in actuality he wants someone to spoil him a little. Lured in by Inukai's charm, Seichi experiences pleasure like he's never known before. They even confess to each other their deepest concerns... This is a heart-throbbing love story between a scheming, career-oriented top and an innocent, mature, husky bottom.
